onboardGate.noAccountBody: Your identity provider signed you in, but Provisa didn't accept the session — it has expired, or this identity has no Provisa account yet. Sign in again to create one. If you were invited to an organization, use your invitation link after signing in.
onboardGate.unavailableBody: Provisa couldn't confirm who you are because the server didn't respond. This is not a problem with your account. Try again in a moment.
